justifications.reuse: both findings of the earlier review at 6e00dd22 are repaired; the forked dispatch.json parse (_report_dispatch_names_run) is deleted in favour of review._plan_review_crew_run_id, the one owner of that read, and the unpoliced _store_delivered_report call is replaced by plan_review.store_delivered_reviews, the existing refusal-recording reader; the join still reuses plan_review.delivered_reports and record_for_review_run rather than adding a scanner.
